correctness.rationale: For a single attacker p(v), exclusion of v forces inclusion of p(v) and inclusion of v excludes p(v); an unattacked vertex must be included. Thus exactly the displayed Boolean complement equations encode stability. Following parent pointers in a weak component terminates at its sole root or sole directed cycle. Each independent even cycle has two phases that disagree at every vertex of its component, including off-cycle vertices; an odd cycle or loop rules out stability globally. Hence each even component contributes 2+2y^{s_i}, and rooted components contribute 1. In the total-map ensemble, partitioning the labelled vertices by agreement versus disagreement of E and H gives two sets each closed under the parent map, since p(v) complements both membership bits. On each set, H is determined by E, so per set the objects are functions decorated by one alternating colouring. An even cycle of length 2j has two such colourings and gives T(z)^{2j}/j. Taking a labelled set of components gives 1/(1−T²) for each set independently. This rederives Q(z)Q(zy), n!q_kq_{n−k}, and the Lagrange coefficient formula; q_0=1, q_1=0 and the ensemble is nonempty for all n≥2. For the limit, T(1/e)=1 and its positive coefficients at every degree imply |T(z)|<1 everywhere else on that circle (the series converges absolutely there). The implicit-function derivative is nonzero there; at 1/e the inverse z=Te^(−T) has a simple quadratic turning point, yielding a square-root expansion in a dented domain. Transfer yields q_m~e^m/(2√(2πm)) and [z^n]Q²~e^n/8. Their ratio gives the stated local law uniformly away from endpoints. Using q_m≤C e^m/√(m+1), each boundary window of relative width ε has mass O(√ε) for sufficiently large n; Riemann sums therefore give the whole beta distribution, not just local convergence. The size-five example follows from q_2=q_3=1, q_5=37/3; the resulting counts 1480,240,240,1480 agree with the recorded small check.
residual_risks: The law is only for uniform ordered triples and includes identical pairs; it is not transferred to a uniform admissible map or a different graph orientation.

value.rationale: The classification is an exact diversity statistic, not just an extension-count formula: branches amplify whole-component disagreements and the polynomial keeps subset-sum multiplicities. The natural pair-decorated model then has a computable finite distribution and a nonconcentrating arcsine limit for the disagreement fraction. Weighting and component sizes are essential, so the combination gives more than an isolated application of a familiar transfer theorem or a recomputation of a metric already tabulated on a different family.
residual_risks: No implication for uniformly selected admissible frameworks or higher attack indegree is claimed.
